d:
A glacial lake outburst flood (GLOF) in Bhutan has triggered flood warnings in parts of West Bengal and Assam. The sudden release of water from Shintaphu Lake has damaged infrastructure in Bhutan and raised concerns over a possible rise in the Sankosh River. Authorities have issued alerts in Alipurduar, Cooch Behar and Dhubri, while NDRF and SDRF teams have been deployed in vulnerable areas. What caused the flood, and which areas in India could be affected?

Video Editor: Rahul Kumar
